home.title: AgoraMesh
home.subtitle: Find and publish public listings through Nostr while agreements, disputes, evidence, and keys stay local.
home.privacyLine: No custody, no KYC, no tracking, and no automatic publishing or importing.
home.heroPanelTitle: Public where useful, private where it matters.
home.heroFlowDiscoverBody: Fetch public marketplace records explicitly before they enter your cache.
home.heroFlowPublishBody: Send only approved public-safe records to relays.
home.heroFlowTradeBody: Draft agreements, mediator choices, and disputes locally.
home.heroFlowProtectBody: Keep keys, evidence, and private terms off public relays.
home.heroPanelFooter: AgoraMesh is a client-side workspace: public discovery through Nostr, private coordination through your chosen channel.
home.howItWorksBody: Create a local identity, browse public records, publish only what you approve, and turn promising listings into private trade drafts.
home.useCasesBody: Post repair help, tutoring, barter requests, local services, mediator availability, and factual reputation notes without a central marketplace account.
home.publicNostrBody: AgoraMesh uses public relay events for discovery. Fetching public marketplace data is explicit, scoped, and separate from publishing.
home.paymentsNoCustodyBody: Listings can show public payment instructions or URIs, but AgoraMesh does not connect wallets, hold funds, confirm settlement, or provide escrow.
home.communityCurationBody: Create and review public curation lists that point to useful marketplace records. Lists help discovery; they do not certify trust.
home.faqBody: Is it local-only? Private trade data is local. Is it public? Marketplace records can be published to relays only when you approve. Is it custodial? No.
home.whatAgoraBody: AgoraMesh is a static, local-first marketplace interface for public discovery and private trade preparation. It helps people publish peaceful public listings, fetch valid public Nostr records, prepare local agreements, and keep dispute details off relays unless they intentionally export them.
home.staysLocalBody: Encrypted identity backups, decrypted signing keys, agreements, full dispute cases, evidence metadata, private settlement text, local moderation choices, and app backups stay on this device unless you export or copy them yourself.
home.canBePublicBody: Profiles, listings, mediator profiles, marketplace reviews, public outcome summaries, payment intents, and curation lists can be published only through explicit actions. Saving a record never publishes it.
home.publicPathBody: Use an existing Nostr account or local identity, fetch valid public marketplace records, create your own public-ready listing, publish explicitly, then move private coordination into Trade.
home.nostrSyncBody: Marketplace fetch requests supported public AgoraMesh events plus NIP-99 listings and caches valid public records directly after your explicit Fetch action. Live sync remains limited to app-open relay listening, and synced public cache records stay separate from your own local records.
home.signerKeysBody: Local encrypted keys remain the default. Optional Nostr signer support, including NIP-07 browser extensions and Amber on Android, can sign public events. External signers are trusted outside AgoraMesh, and AgoraMesh rejects modified events or mismatched author keys.
home.tradeDisputesBody: Trade turns listings into local agreement drafts, mediator selections, dispute records, and exports. Full agreements and disputes are not public Nostr objects in this MVP.
home.communityTrustBody: Allowlists, relay scores, curation lists, conflict labels, and marketplace reviews are context for judgment. They are not global moderation, identity verification, or guarantees of truth.
home.releaseVerificationBody: Release builds are static artifacts with checksums and a manifest. Verify SHA256SUMS and lockfile-based builds before hosting or trusting a downloaded copy.
home.securityPromisesBody: No custody, no KYC, no tracking, no automatic publish, no automatic import, memory-only decrypted keys, explicit review, and private trade data kept local or export-only.
home.publicMarketplaceBody: Browse local and synced public listings, then publish your own records only when you choose.
home.privateTradeBody: Turn a listing into local agreement text, mediator notes, disputes, and exports without publishing private terms.
home.trustSyncBody: Fetch public Nostr records into the synced cache with an explicit action, and use allowlists as filters rather than proof.
home.localSecurityBody: Encrypted identity keys, backups, dispute bundles, and local cache controls stay on your device unless you export them.
home.whatBody: A privacy-respecting marketplace MVP for peaceful offers, requests, mediators, agreements, and signed marketplace reviews.
home.howBody: Your data starts on your device. You can publish public listings or reviews to configurable Nostr relays, while private disputes and keys stay local.
home.privacyBody: Pseudonymous does not mean anonymous. Relays can see public events you publish. Do not post exact addresses publicly.
home.disputeBody: Participants can agree on an optional mediator before trade. Cases are local-first and outcomes are published only by explicit choice.
home.safetyBody: No violence, weapons, stolen goods, coercion, fraud, exploitation, doxxing, or non-consensual activity.
onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.body: Work through these steps to keep control of your identity, publish intentionally, and review public sync before trusting it.
onboarding.identity: Create an identity, export the backup, and verify the passphrase before publishing.
onboarding.listing: Create a public-ready offer or request with an approximate region and a reachable contact method.
onboarding.publish: Add relays only when you want public federation; publishing is always an explicit action.
onboarding.review: Fetch public marketplace records from enabled relays. Valid records enter the synced cache only after your explicit Fetch action.
onboarding.dispute: Keep disputes local by default and prefer encrypted bundles when sharing case details.

hint.requiredPublic: Required. If later published, keep it suitable for public relay storage.
hint.listingDescription: Avoid exact addresses, private payment secrets, and sensitive personal details.
hint.contactPublic: This contact can become public when the listing is published.
hint.listingStatus: NIP-99 status is public when published. Use deleted only to publish a removal marker.
hint.pricePublic: Price fields are public NIP-99 metadata. Do not include private invoices, secrets, escrow, or custody instructions.
hint.disabledIdentity: Create an identity first; this prevents orphaned local records.
hint.disabledProfile: Create an identity and profile first so mediator records can be attributed.
hint.disabledUnlock: Unlock the identity for signing; the decrypted key remains in memory only.
hint.identityPassphrase: Used to encrypt the private key locally. AgoraMesh cannot recover it.
hint.unlockPassphrase: Unlock only for signing or backup verification, then lock again when done.
hint.profilePublic: Profile fields can be published if public visibility is enabled.
hint.mediatorProcedure: Keep expectations concrete so participants understand the process before choosing you.
hint.agreementLocal: Agreements are local drafts unless you share the copied text yourself.
hint.disputeLocal: Dispute details stay local unless you export them.
hint.bundlePassphrase: Share this passphrase out of band; it is not stored or recoverable.
hint.reputationSubject: The key being reviewed; signatures prove authorship, not truth.
hint.reputationPublic: Published reviews are public claims. Keep them factual and minimal.
hint.relayAdd: Relays are optional. Add only relays you intentionally want to contact.
hint.reviewPassphrase: Only needed for encrypted AgoraMesh events you intentionally want to inspect.
hint.allowlistKey: Allowlists help filtering; they do not verify identity or guarantee safety.
hint.unlockPassphraseShort: Unlock only when signing, then lock again.
hint.identityPassphraseShort: Encrypts the private key locally. It cannot be recovered.
hint.backupNext: Export a backup before relying on this identity for publishing.
hint.paymentIntent: Optional and public. Do not include seeds, secrets, private invoice memos, refund secrets, private settlement details, escrow wording, or custody claims.
hint.listingImages: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Up to 6 images, 5 MB each. Do not upload private documents, evidence, faces, exact addresses, or receipts.
guided.identityBody: Start with an encrypted local identity before saving user-owned records.
guided.backupBody: Confirm the passphrase or export the identity before publishing public events.
guided.profileBody: Add only public-safe profile details so listings have clear context.
guided.listingBody: Create a public-ready offer or request. Publishing to relays still requires an explicit action.
guided.relayTitle: Add a relay when you want federation
guided.relayBody: Relays are optional. The app remains usable offline without them.
guided.browseBody: Your core setup is ready. Discover records, create listings, or publish from My listings when you choose.
help.browse: Marketplace shows local listings and public records you approved from sync. Public sync is for discovery; private trade details stay in Trade.
help.profile: Profile contact methods may become public if you publish the profile. Use approximate regions and avoid secrets.
help.mediatorCreate: Mediator profiles are public-facing when published. Keep procedures clear and avoid promises you cannot verify.
help.syncedTrust: Synced mediator records stay separate from your local records. Hide noisy records locally without deleting relay data.
help.agreement: Agreement text is local and copyable. Share it only through a channel both parties trust.
help.reputationBrowse: Reviews are signed public claims from other keys. Verify signatures, then judge the context yourself.
help.reviewQueue: This advanced queue is for diagnostics and unusual public events. Normal Marketplace fetch stores valid public records directly. Valid signatures only prove authorship of the event, not truth or safety.
help.allowlist: Allowlists mark authors as familiar to you or your community. They are filters, not identity verification.
safety.publicPublish: Public publishing sends this listing and its contact method to enabled relays. Relays may retain and mirror it.
safety.nip99Publish: AgoraMesh publishes marketplace listings as NIP-99 classified listings. Title, description, location, price, status, images, tags, and contact metadata are public relay data.
safety.listingVisibility: Public-ready listings are prepared for relay publishing but are not sent automatically. Local and draft listings stay on this device.
safety.disputePrivate: Do not put private evidence files or exact addresses into public summaries. Dispute cases stay local unless you export them.
safety.plainDisputeExport: Plain JSON export is unencrypted. Use encrypted bundle export when another party should receive case details.
safety.reputation: Reviews are public claims when published. Keep text factual, minimal, and free of private dispute details, payment secrets, or exact logistics.
safety.syncMetadata: Live sync and manual fetch contact relays directly. Relays can observe timing, public keys, and requested AgoraMesh or NIP-99 event kinds.
safety.blossomImages: Blossom uploads are public media uploads. Servers and anyone with the URL may retain or mirror images outside AgoraMesh.
empty.browseBody: Add a relay and fetch public marketplace records, publish your own public-ready listing, or adjust filters.
empty.listingsBody: Create an offer or request first. It stays local until you explicitly publish it from Marketplace.
empty.mediatorsBody: Create a mediator profile, fetch public mediator records for review, or change source and visibility filters.
empty.disputesBody: Disputes are created from agreement hashes and remain local unless you export a bundle.
empty.agreementsBody: Create a trade agreement if you want private terms and receipts; reviews can also be written directly from marketplace listings.
empty.reputationBody: Create a signed review after unlocking your identity, or fetch public reviews into the public cache.
empty.reviewBody: Add at least one enabled relay, then fetch for review. Nothing is imported into the public cache automatically.
empty.relayHealthBody: Add a relay and fetch or publish to build local health and receipt history.
empty.syncedProfilesTitle: No synced profiles in this view
empty.syncedProfilesBody: Approved profile events appear here, separate from your own local profile.
empty.syncedListingsTitle: No synced listings in this view
empty.syncedListingsBody: Approved non-expired listing events appear here. Enable expired listings if you need older records.
empty.disputeOutcomesBody: Only explicit public outcome summaries can appear here after public cache fetch or advanced diagnostics import.
empty.allowlistBody: Add public keys you already recognize, or import a community allowlist after reviewing its notes.
empty.receiptsBody: Receipts appear after you publish public profiles, listings, mediator profiles, or reviews to relays.
empty.identityBody: Create an encrypted identity before exporting an identity backup.
empty.tradeAgreementBody: Create an agreement from a listing before opening a dispute. Agreement terms stay local unless you share the text yourself.
empty.curationBody: Create a local list from visible Marketplace records, or import reviewed public lists from relays.
identity.title: Pseudonymous identity
identity.body: Generate a Nostr-compatible keypair in this browser. The private key is encrypted at rest with your passphrase and is never transmitted.
identity.lost: Losing the key means losing the identity. Export a backup and store it carefully.
identity.existingBody: Connect a browser signer and use that public key as your AgoraMesh identity. No extension private key is stored.
identity.existingBodyCompact: Connect your Nostr signer and use that public key as your AgoraMesh identity.
identity.generateBody: Create a new local keypair encrypted by a passphrase for users without an existing Nostr account.
identity.extensionConnected: Nostr account connected. Signatures will be requested from the browser signer.
identity.extensionReconnect: Reconnect the same browser signer before signing with this identity.
identity.extensionBackup: This identity uses your browser signer. AgoraMesh has no private key to export; keep your signer account backed up outside AgoraMesh.
identity.extensionNoPrivateKey: Extension-backed identities do not store an AgoraMesh private key.
identity.switchConfirm: Switch active AgoraMesh identity to this Nostr signer? Existing local records will not be rewritten.
identity.metadataBody: Optionally fetch standard Nostr profile metadata from enabled relays to prefill local profile fields. This queries relays for your public key and does not publish anything.
identity.metadataImported: Nostr profile metadata filled local profile fields.
identity.metadataMissing: No usable Nostr profile metadata was found on enabled relays.
identity.backupMissing: Identity backup is not confirmed. Export the identity or verify the passphrase before publishing.
identity.backupBeforePublish: Export or verify your identity backup before publishing public events.
identity.forgetBody: This removes only the active identity from this browser. Marketplace records, trade records, review cache, and backups are not rewritten. A generated local key cannot be recovered from AgoraMesh after forgetting it.
identity.forgetConfirm: Forget the active identity from this browser? Existing records stay local but will not be rewritten to a new identity.
profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHelp: Profiles use this public image as marketplace context, not identity verification.
profile.avatarUrlHelp: Use an HTTPS image URL or upload one to an enabled Blossom media server.
profile.avatarUploadHelp: The selected image uploads when you save the profile.
profile.avatarUploadFailed: Avatar upload failed. The previous avatar URL was not changed.
profile.avatarNoBlossomServer: Add and enable a Blossom media server in Settings to upload an avatar.
profile.avatarSignerRequired: Unlock the local key or connect the matching Nostr signer before uploading an avatar.
profile.lightningHelp: Public Lightning payment info for marketplace invoice handoff. AgoraMesh does not hold funds, execute wallet payments, or provide escrow.
profile.mediatorMarketplaceHelp: These public details make the mediator directory useful. Saving still stays local; publish the mediator profile separately when ready.
profile.mediatorIncomplete: Your public profile says mediator availability is enabled, but the mediator marketplace profile is not complete locally yet.
profile.mediatorSignalIncomplete: This public profile says the author is available as a mediator, but no reviewed mediator profile with fee, procedure, and response details has been imported.
profile.saveError: Profile could not be saved. Review the highlighted marketplace fields and try again.
profile.compactBody: Manage identity, public profile details, and backups one step at a time.
listing.title: Listings
listing.notFound: This listing is not available in local records or the reviewed public cache.
listing.imageLimit: Only the first 6 images will be used.
listing.noBlossomServer: Add and enable a Blossom media server in Settings to upload public listing images. You can still save without images.
listing.imageSignerRequired: Unlock the local key or connect the matching Nostr signer before uploading images.
listing.imageSignerLink: The connected signer is not the active listing identity. Use it as the active identity before uploading images.
listing.imageUploadFailed: Image upload failed. Clear the selected image or try another media server before saving.
listing.saveError: Listing could not be saved. Review the highlighted fields and try again.
listing.guardrails: Community safety: peaceful services and goods only. No coercion, fraud, exploitation, stolen goods, doxxing, weapons, or violence.
listing.lightningOverrideHelp: Optional public LNURL/lightning address for this listing. If empty, the seller profile Lightning address is used.
listing.paymentOptionsHelp: Public non-executed options for buyer coordination. AgoraMesh does not handle cash, barter, or wallet settlement.
listing.readiness.title: Listing readiness
listing.readiness.identityReady: Saved listings will be tied to your active public key.
listing.readiness.identityMissing: Create or connect an identity before saving a listing.
listing.readiness.essentialsReady: Title, description, location, and contact are filled.
listing.readiness.essentialsMissing: Add title, description, location, and contact before saving.
listing.readiness.visibilityPublic: Public-ready means reviewable for relay publishing later. Saving still stays local.
listing.readiness.visibilityLocal: Local and draft listings stay on this device unless you change visibility and publish later.
listing.readiness.mediaNoServer: Images are selected, but no Blossom media server is enabled. Saving can continue without images.
listing.readiness.mediaReady: Images can be uploaded with the current media server and signer.
listing.readiness.mediaSigner: Images are selected. Unlock the local key or connect the matching signer to upload them.
seller.notVerified: Signatures and local trust context do not verify legal identity or fulfillment.
marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Search public and local listings. Open details for contact, publishing, and private trade.
marketplace.createBody: Save the listing locally first. Publishing stays explicit.
marketplace.searchPlaceholder: Search listings, skills, regions, tags, or public descriptions
marketplace.myListingsBody: Open a saved listing to review, edit, or publish it as a NIP-99 classified.
marketplace.publishLaterBody: Saving creates a local public-ready listing. Publishing to relays happens only from My listings after you review the details.
marketplace.noEnabledRelays: Add and enable a relay before publishing.
marketplace.noReceipts: No relay receipts for this listing yet.
marketplace.whySortedBody: Marketplace ranking prefers visible, active, trusted, local, newer, and search-matching records. Curation lists are optional discovery filters, not trust guarantees.
marketplace.reviewFetchedBody: Fetched events were added to advanced diagnostics. Normal Marketplace Fetch still caches valid public records directly.
marketplace.reviewEmptyBody: No new diagnostic events were fetched. You can keep browsing existing Marketplace records.
marketplace.fetchFailed: Fetch failed. Check relay connectivity and try again.
marketplace.fetchScopeHelp: This controls both visible synced listings and the next relay fetch.
marketplace.fetchActiveScope: Next fetch uses {scope}. Valid public records are cached directly; publishing remains separate.
marketplace.fetchSummary: {imported} imported, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {skipped} skipped, {invalid} invalid from {relays} relays.
empty.browseNoRelays: Add or enable a relay to discover public records, or create a local public-ready listing first.
empty.browsePendingReview: Public records are waiting in review. Import selected valid items, then return to Marketplace.
empty.browseNoRecords: No local or synced public listings are available yet. Create a listing or fetch public marketplace records.
empty.browseNoMatches: No visible records match these filters. Clear filters or include expired, hidden, local, or synced records.
marketplace.guidance.createBody: Start with an offer or request. It stays local until you explicitly publish it.
marketplace.guidance.relayTitle: Add a relay when you want public reach
marketplace.guidance.relayBody: Relays make publishing and public discovery useful. The app still works locally without them.
marketplace.guidance.reviewBody: Pending Nostr events need your approval before they enter the public cache.
marketplace.guidance.fetchBody: Use your enabled relays to cache valid public records directly. Invalid, encrypted, expired-hidden, or out-of-scope events are skipped.
marketplace.guidance.publishBody: Your listing is saved locally. Open My listings, review contact details, then publish if you want relay federation.
marketplace.guidance.tradeBody: Use a local or reviewed public listing to prefill a local agreement. Trade details are not published.
curation.title: Community curation lists
curation.body: Build public lists that reference approved Marketplace records. Lists are discovery aids, not verification, certification, or moderation.
curation.noCandidates: No visible records are available to reference.
curation.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one visible Marketplace record.
review.bulkResult: Bulk import finished: {imported} imported, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed, {rejected} rejected.
agreement.title: Agreement builder
agreement.publicKeyHint: Signed receipts verify these public keys, not display names.
agreement.receiptsBody: Receipts prove that a specific Nostr key accepted this agreement hash. Share agreement packets and receipts through your chosen external channel; AgoraMesh does not provide escrow or legal enforcement.
agreement.stepPrepareBody: Save an agreement with buyer and seller public keys.
agreement.stepSharePacketBody: Copy or download the private agreement packet for the counterparty.
agreement.stepSignBody: Each party signs the same agreement hash with their matching key.
agreement.stepMutualBody: Import the counterparty receipt to prove both configured keys accepted the hash.
agreement.stepMutualDone: Both buyer and seller receipts are verified.
agreement.keysUnverified: Public keys are intended signers only until valid receipts from those keys are present.
agreement.disabledMissingBuyerKey: Add the buyer public key before signing as buyer.
agreement.disabledMissingSellerKey: Add the seller public key before signing as seller.
agreement.disabledNoSigner: Connect a browser signer or create a local identity before signing.
agreement.disabledLockedKey: Unlock the local identity key before signing.
agreement.disabledSignerMismatch: The active signer public key does not match this role.
agreement.receiptImported: Agreement receipt verified and saved locally.
agreement.receiptInvalid: Agreement receipt could not be verified.
agreement.receiptMalformed: Agreement receipt file is not valid JSON in the expected format.
agreement.receiptNoAgreement: Import the matching agreement packet before importing this receipt.
agreement.receiptDuplicate: This agreement receipt was already imported.
agreement.disputeUnsignedWarning: This agreement is not mutually signed. You can open a dispute, but the agreement has weaker receipt evidence.
mediator.title: Mediator directory
mediator.philosophy: Voluntary, consent-based, non-custodial, transparent, with conflict-of-interest disclosure.
dispute.title: Dispute cases
dispute.exportPlainConfirm: This exports unencrypted dispute details to a local JSON file. Continue only if you intend to handle that file securely.
dispute.privacy: Evidence files are never uploaded. Export a dispute bundle JSON when you choose to share it.
trade.title: Trade workspace
trade.body: Use public listings and mediators to prepare private local agreements, disputes, and exports.
trade.privateBoundary: Agreement terms, dispute details, evidence metadata, payment secrets, and settlement text stay local unless you export or copy them yourself.
trade.localNotice: Trade details stay local; copy or export them through your chosen channel.
trade.mediatorBody: Choose a local or reviewed public mediator and copy the selection into the agreement draft.
trade.outcomeBody: Manage local dispute exports. Full dispute cases are not published to relays.
reputation.title: Marketplace reviews
reputation.body: Write and browse signed public marketplace reviews. Reviews are public claims, not identity verification or fulfillment proof.
reputation.subject: Subject public key
reputation.reviewPromptBody: Mutually signed agreements can be reviewed publicly. Choose the counterparty you want to rate.
reputation.duplicateReview: You already have a local review for this reviewer, subject, and listing/agreement context.
reputation.signerMismatch: The connected signer does not match the active identity.
reputation.signerRequired: Reconnect the active browser signer before signing this review.
reputation.unlockRequired: Unlock the local identity or connect the matching signer before signing.

reputation.contextBody: Seller trust summaries group verified signed reviews by subject key. They are judgment context, not proof of legal identity or fulfillment.
nostr.title: Nostr relays
nostr.note: Relays are optional federation infrastructure. The app remains usable without them.
nostrContact.title: Encrypted Nostr intro
nostrContact.metadataWarning: Message content is encrypted with NIP-44/NIP-17, but relays can still observe sender/recipient involvement, relay choice, timing, and event size.
nostrContact.copyFallback: Your current key path cannot send NIP-44 messages here. Use the copy actions with your Nostr client.
nostrContact.includeContext: Include this context in the encrypted message
nostrContact.placeholder: Write a short intro. Do not include payment secrets, private agreement terms, dispute evidence, or settlement data unless you intentionally choose to send it.
nostrContact.sent: Encrypted Nostr intro sent. Only receipt metadata was saved locally.
nostrContact.sentFailed: Encrypted Nostr intro could not be accepted by any enabled relay. Receipt metadata was saved.
nostrContact.sentFailedCompact: Message was not accepted by any enabled relay.
nostrContact.sendFailed: Could not send encrypted Nostr intro.
nostrContact.invalidRecipient: Enter a valid npub, nprofile, nostr URI, or hex public key.
nostrContact.identityRequired: Create or connect an identity before sending a Nostr message.
nostrContact.relaysRequired: Enable at least one relay before sending.
nostrContact.signerRequired: Reconnect the matching signer or unlock the local key before sending.

nostrContact.lookupHint: NIP-17 gift wraps are signed by one-time random keys and may use privacy-randomized timestamps. Search by event ID or recipient #p tag, not by your pubkey.
nostrContact.noReceiptsBody: Sent intro messages will appear here as event and relay receipts. Plaintext message bodies are not stored.
nostrInbox.title: Nostr encrypted inbox
nostrInbox.pageBody: Fetch and read NIP-17 encrypted Nostr messages only when you choose. Readable bodies stay in a passphrase-protected local cache.
nostrInbox.metadataWarning: Inbox messages are NIP-44 encrypted inside NIP-17 gift wraps. Relays can still observe recipient #p tags, timing, event size, relay choice, and fetch behavior.
nostrInbox.passphrasePlaceholder: Separate passphrase for readable message cache
nostrInbox.decryptFallback: This identity cannot decrypt NIP-17 messages here. Use event IDs or npubs with an external Nostr client that supports NIP-17/NIP-44.
nostrInbox.unlockFailed: Could not unlock the encrypted inbox cache with that passphrase.
nostrInbox.fetchFailed: Could not fetch encrypted Nostr messages.
nostrInbox.emptyBody: Unlock the inbox cache or fetch NIP-17 messages from enabled relays. Nothing is fetched automatically.
nostrInbox.unlockToRead: Unlock the inbox cache to read message bodies. Plaintext is not stored after lock or reload.
nostrInbox.noDecryptedMessages: No readable messages in this thread yet.
nostrInbox.identityRequired: Create or connect an identity before fetching Nostr messages.
nostrInbox.signerRequired: Reconnect the matching signer or unlock the local key before fetching messages.
nostrInbox.signerNoDecrypt: This signer does not expose NIP-44 decryption.
nostrInbox.passphraseTooShort: Use an inbox passphrase with at least 10 characters.
nostrInbox.fetchComplete: Encrypted inbox fetch complete. Imported {count} messages.
payment.invoiceHandoff: Generate a NIP-57 zap request and LNURL invoice, then pay it in your own wallet. AgoraMesh only watches for a public zap receipt.
payment.publicNotePlaceholder: Optional public note included in the zap request
payment.identityRequired: Create or connect an identity before generating a zap request.
payment.signerRequired: Reconnect the matching signer or unlock the local key before generating a zap request.
payment.amountRequired: Enter a positive amount in sats.
payment.invoiceFailed: Could not generate the Lightning invoice.
payment.receiptNotFound: No matching zap receipt found on enabled relays yet.
payment.metadataWarning: Zap requests and receipts are public Nostr events. Relays and the LNURL service can see amount, participants, listing reference, timing, relay choice, and any public note. A zap receipt is not escrow, fulfillment proof, identity verification, or a delivery guarantee.
payment.noAttemptsBody: Generated Lightning invoices and matched zap receipts will appear here as metadata only.
support.title: AgoraMesh supporter badge
support.body: Pay at least {amount} sats to {operator} to cache a public supporter badge for this profile. It is a payment signal only, not trust or verification.
support.alreadyPaid: A qualifying public support receipt is already cached for this profile. The pay option is hidden to avoid duplicate support payments.
support.badgeTitle: Validated public support zap of at least {amount} sats.
support.metadataWarning: Support zaps and receipts are public Nostr events. Relays and the LNURL service can see amount, payer, operator recipient, timing, relay choice, and any public note. The badge is not identity verification, endorsement, trust, moderation approval, escrow, or fulfillment proof.
support.notConfigured: Operator support is not configured for this build.
support.receiptNotFound: No matching operator support receipt found on enabled relays yet.
support.noReceiptsBody: Validated public support zaps will appear here as metadata-only badge receipts.
nwc.title: Lightning wallet
nwc.body: Connect one NWC wallet for non-custodial invoice payment. AgoraMesh encrypts the connection locally and never includes it in backups.
nwc.testFailed: Could not reach the NWC wallet.
nwc.unlockFailed: Could not unlock the wallet connection.
nwc.unlockRequired: Unlock the Lightning wallet before paying.
nwc.noWalletInline: Connect an NWC wallet to pay in one step, or generate an invoice from details and pay externally.
nwc.notBackedUp: The wallet connection is encrypted locally and intentionally excluded from backups.
nwc.confirmationWarning: Your wallet may ask you to confirm payment depending on its policy and spending limits. AgoraMesh cannot force wallet-side prompts.
nwc.retryWarning: Retry only if your wallet did not pay the previous invoice.
nwc.duplicateWarning: Payment was already sent for this invoice. Create a new invoice before paying again.
signer.title: Nostr signer
signer.body: Use an optional Nostr signer for public publishing, including NIP-07 browser extensions or Amber on Android, or keep using the local encrypted key. External signers are trusted outside AgoraMesh; AgoraMesh never stores signer private keys and rejects modified signed events.
signer.status.unavailable.body: No Nostr signer is currently detected. Try again after enabling nos2x or another NIP-07 extension, or use Amber on Android.
signer.status.available.body: A browser signer is available but not connected yet.
signer.status.connected.body: The signer is connected but is not saved as the active AgoraMesh identity.
signer.status.connected-mismatch.body: The connected signer public key does not match the active AgoraMesh identity.
signer.status.active-identity.body: This signer matches the active AgoraMesh identity and can sign matching records.
signer.pubkeyMismatch: Connected signer public key does not match this object author.
sync.fetchInvalid: Some fetched events were invalid and were skipped.
sync.live: Live sync while app is open
sync.outgoingNote: Live sync listens for public incoming events. Outgoing sync happens when you publish a profile, listing, mediator profile, review, or curation list.
sync.listingDiscoveryScopeHelp: AgoraMesh-native asks relays for NIP-99 listings tagged for AgoraMesh. All NIP-99 can increase cached marketplace volume and relay metadata exposure.
sync.label: Label
sync.importAllowlistConfirm: Import this allowlist only if you reviewed its source. Notes and labels can influence local trust filters.
sync.wizard.title: Public Sync Wizard
sync.wizard.body: Use Marketplace Fetch for public records. Settings keeps relays, cache, trust, and diagnostics visible without automatic publishing.
sync.wizard.relaysReady: At least one relay is enabled for public marketplace sync.
sync.wizard.relaysMissing: Add or enable a relay before fetching public records.
sync.wizard.fetchReady: Public records are available in the local cache.
sync.wizard.fetchNeeded: Open Marketplace and fetch public records when you want fresh discovery.
sync.wizard.importReady: Approved public records are in the local public cache.
sync.wizard.importNeeded: No public records are cached yet. Marketplace Fetch writes valid records directly after your explicit action.
sync.wizard.marketplacePublish: Open Marketplace to publish your own listing or browse public records.
sync.wizard.marketplaceBrowse: Open Marketplace to fetch public records, browse cache results, or create your own listing.
settings.title: Settings and portability
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete all local AgoraMesh data from this browser? This cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
settings.privacyBody: Keep sensitive dispute evidence local unless you trust the recipient. Relays can see public events you publish.
settings.accountSignerBody: The browser signer is optional and externally trusted. AgoraMesh stores no extension private keys; reconnect the same signer before signing extension-backed records.
settings.workspaceToolsBody: Trade agreements, mediator records, and reputation tools stay available here without crowding the main marketplace navigation.
settings.reviewDiagnosticsBody: Use this only for encrypted, invalid, or unsupported public events. Normal marketplace fetching writes valid public records directly to the cache.
about.title: Principles
about.body: Voluntary exchange, non-violence, no KYC, no custodial funds, no tracking, no dark patterns, and no platform lock-in.
